_meta.name: grounder-support-gold
_meta.review_status: quotes verified against primary sources via web research 2026-06-05 (EUR-Lex/official mirrors, gesetze-im-internet, WIPO/Cornell, arxiv.org, doi.org, creativecommons.org, copyright.gov); LABELS still pending expert review / sign-off before this set gates production

labels.supports: the quote establishes the claim (directly or by faithful paraphrase)
labels.does_not_support: the quote contradicts or refutes the claim
labels.insufficient: the quote neither establishes nor refutes the claim (off-topic, partial, scope mismatch, missing premise)

bar.notes: fatal inversion = gold does_not_support predicted as supports; predicting insufficient on a decided gold label is safe escalation, not error, but counts against decided_fraction; deciding on a gold insufficient is an overconfidence error

claim: The EU AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024.
quote: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, the Artificial Intelligence Act, was published in the Official Journal on 12 July 2024 and entered into force on 1 August 2024.
label: supports
rationale: direct statement of the claimed date (secondary-source phrasing; dates web-verified)

claim: GDPR fines can reach 4% of total worldwide annual turnover.
quote: administrative fines up to 20 000 000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
label: supports
rationale: Art. 83(5) upper band matches the claim (partial quote, verbatim)

claim: The Transformer architecture dispenses with recurrence.
quote: the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely
label: supports
rationale: verbatim support (Vaswani et al. 2017 abstract)

claim: Member States must designate computer security incident response teams under NIS2.
quote: Each Member State shall designate or establish one or more CSIRTs.
label: supports
rationale: Art. 10(1) verbatim (body text uses the acronym); designate-or-establish covers the claim

claim: High-risk AI systems must be designed so that natural persons can oversee them effectively.
quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.
label: supports
rationale: Art. 14(1) verbatim, same scope

claim: Under German copyright law, the author can prohibit distortions of their work.
quote: Der Urheber hat das Recht, eine Entstellung oder eine andere Beeinträchtigung seines Werkes zu verbieten, die geeignet ist, seine berechtigten geistigen oder persönlichen Interessen am Werk zu gefährden.
label: supports
rationale: § 14 UrhG verbatim; cross-lingual support (DE quote, EN claim)

claim: Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models apply from 2 August 2025.
quote: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101.
label: insufficient
rationale: Art. 113(b) verbatim: deciding requires the unstated premise that Chapter V contains the GPAI provider obligations — the quote alone neither establishes nor refutes

claim: Controllers must notify personal data breaches to the supervisory authority within 72 hours where feasible.
quote: the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority
label: supports
rationale: Art. 33(1) verbatim span, same deadline and same feasibility qualifier

claim: The Berne Convention gives authors the exclusive right to authorise translations of their works.
quote: Authors of literary and artistic works protected by this Convention shall enjoy the exclusive right of making and of authorizing the translation of their works throughout the term of protection of their rights in the original works.
label: supports
rationale: Art. 8 verbatim ('authorizing' is the official spelling)

claim: Self-attention has quadratic computational cost in sequence length.
quote: the self-attention layer requires computation that scales as O(n^2 · d) with sequence length n
label: supports
rationale: O(n^2) in n is what 'quadratic in sequence length' asserts

claim: arXiv does not peer-review the papers it hosts.
quote: Material is not peer-reviewed by arXiv - the contents of arXiv submissions are wholly the responsibility of the submitter and are presented 'as is' without any warranty or guarantee.
label: supports
rationale: current about-page wording, verbatim; direct negative statement matches negative claim

claim: A DOI remains assigned to its object permanently.
quote: A DOI name is permanently assigned to an object to provide a resolvable persistent network link to current information about that object.
label: supports
rationale: DOI Handbook (legacy edition) verbatim; direct

claim: Reusing CC BY licensed material requires crediting the creator.
quote: You must give appropriate credit, provide a link to the license, and indicate if changes were made.
label: supports
rationale: CC BY 4.0 deed attribution condition, verbatim

claim: Some practices, such as social scoring, are prohibited under the AI Act.
quote: The following AI practices shall be prohibited: ... the placing on the market, the putting into service or the use of AI systems for the evaluation or classification of natural persons or groups of persons over a certain period of time based on their social behaviour or known, inferred or predicted personal or personality characteristics, with the social score leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment of certain natural persons or groups of persons that is unjustified or disproportionate to their social behaviour or its gravity
label: supports
rationale: Art. 5(1) chapeau + 5(1)(c) limb (ii), verbatim with marked elision; one prohibited practice establishes the existential claim

claim: Rightholders can opt their works out of commercial text and data mining under EU law by machine-readable reservation.
quote: on condition that the use of works and other subject matter referred to in that paragraph has not been expressly reserved by their rightholders in an appropriate manner, such as machine-readable means in the case of content made publicly available online
label: supports
rationale: DSM Art. 4(3) verbatim span; the reservation mechanism entails the opt-out the claim describes

claim: NIS2 requires an early warning within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident.
quote: without undue delay and in any event within 24 hours of becoming aware of the significant incident, an early warning, which, where applicable, shall indicate whether the significant incident is suspected of being caused by unlawful or malicious acts or could have a cross-border impact
label: supports
rationale: Art. 23(4)(a) verbatim, official word order

claim: German law guarantees authors a claim to equitable remuneration for the exploitation of their works.
quote: Der Urheber hat für die Einräumung von Nutzungsrechten und die Erlaubnis zur Werknutzung Anspruch auf die vertraglich vereinbarte Vergütung. Ist die Höhe der Vergütung nicht bestimmt, gilt die angemessene Vergütung als vereinbart.
label: supports
rationale: § 32(1) S. 1–2 UrhG verbatim (two sentences); angemessene Vergütung = equitable remuneration; cross-lingual

claim: Ed25519 signatures are deterministic for a given key and message.
quote: Ed25519 is a deterministic signature scheme: signing the same message with the same private key always produces the same signature.
label: supports
rationale: direct

claim: GDPR fines are capped at 2% of worldwide turnover in all cases.
quote: administrative fines up to 20 000 000 EUR, or in the case of an undertaking, up to 4 % of the total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding financial year, whichever is higher
label: does_not_support
rationale: quote contradicts the 2%-in-all-cases cap (Art. 83(5) band reaches 4%)

claim: The GDPR became applicable in 2016.
quote: It shall apply from 25 May 2018.
label: does_not_support
rationale: Art. 99(2) verbatim; date contradiction (entry into force 2016 ≠ applicability)

claim: arXiv peer-reviews every submission.
quote: Material is not peer-reviewed by arXiv - the contents of arXiv submissions are wholly the responsibility of the submitter and are presented 'as is' without any warranty or guarantee.
label: does_not_support
rationale: explicit negation of the claim (current about-page wording)

claim: Copyright in Germany is freely transferable during the author's lifetime.
quote: Das Urheberrecht ist nicht übertragbar, es sei denn, es wird in Erfüllung einer Verfügung von Todes wegen oder an Miterben im Wege der Erbauseinandersetzung übertragen.
label: does_not_support
rationale: § 29(1) UrhG verbatim: not transferable inter vivos — contradiction, cross-lingual

claim: No obligation under the AI Act applies before August 2026.
quote: Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025.
label: does_not_support
rationale: Art. 113(a) verbatim; prohibitions apply 18 months earlier — contradiction

claim: CC BY allows reuse without crediting the creator.
quote: You must give appropriate credit, provide a link to the license, and indicate if changes were made.
label: does_not_support
rationale: attribution is mandatory — contradiction

claim: A DOI is reassigned when the publisher's website moves.
quote: A DOI name is permanently assigned to an object to provide a resolvable persistent network link to current information about that object.
label: does_not_support
rationale: permanence contradicts reassignment-on-move

claim: NIS2 gives entities three months to submit the final incident report.
quote: a final report not later than one month after the submission of the incident notification under point (b)
label: does_not_support
rationale: Art. 23(4)(d) verbatim; one month, not three — numeric contradiction

claim: In Germany, GEMA is the collecting society responsible for performers' neighbouring rights.
quote: Die GVL ist die deutsche Verwertungsgesellschaft für die Leistungsschutzrechte von ausübenden Künstler*innen und Tonträgerhersteller*innen.
label: does_not_support
rationale: entity swap: GVL's official self-description (verbatim) attributes that role to GVL, not GEMA

claim: The EU AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024.
quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union.
label: insufficient
rationale: Art. 113 verbatim: rule without the publication date — cannot derive the claimed date from the quote alone

claim: All AI systems must undergo third-party conformity assessment under the AI Act.
quote: high-risk AI systems shall undergo the relevant conformity assessment procedure prior to their placing on the market or putting into service
label: insufficient
rationale: quote covers high-risk only; neither establishes nor refutes the universal 'all' (and says nothing about third-party)

claim: Pseudonymised data is outside the scope of the GDPR.
quote: The principles of data protection should apply to any information concerning an identified or identifiable natural person.
label: insufficient
rationale: Recital 26 first sentence verbatim; alone it does not settle whether pseudonymised data is identifiable — the answer needs the recital's continuation

claim: The DSA requires AI model providers to register their models.
quote: Providers of very large online platforms shall publish transparency reports on their content moderation activities.
label: insufficient
rationale: off-topic: quote is about platform transparency reports, says nothing about AI model registration

claim: Larger language models always produce more factual answers.
quote: scaling model size improves performance on many benchmarks
label: insufficient
rationale: 'many benchmarks' neither establishes nor refutes 'always more factual'

claim: A sync licence covering Germany also covers worldwide exploitation.
quote: The Licensor grants the Licensee the right to synchronise the Composition with the Picture for exploitation within the Territory.
label: insufficient
rationale: contract-style clause defers to an undefined 'Territory' — cannot decide without the definition clause

claim: NIS2 applies to a medium-sized cloud computing provider established in Germany.
quote: This Directive applies to public or private entities of a type referred to in Annex I or II which qualify as medium-sized enterprises under Article 2 of the Annex to Recommendation 2003/361/EC, or exceed the ceilings for medium-sized enterprises provided for in paragraph 1 of that Article
label: insufficient
rationale: Art. 2(1) span: needs the missing premise that cloud computing is in Annex I/II; quote alone doesn't decide

claim: US fair use permits training AI models on copyrighted books.
quote: Notwithstanding the provisions of sections 106 and 106A, the fair use of a copyrighted work, including such use by reproduction in copies or phonorecords or by any other means specified by that section, for purposes such as criticism, comment, news reporting, teaching (including multiple copies for classroom use), scholarship, or research, is not an infringement of copyright.
label: insufficient
rationale: 17 U.S.C. § 107 first sentence verbatim; lists factors and examples — neither establishes nor refutes the specific training-use conclusion

claim: A data protection officer must be appointed by every company processing personal data.
quote: The controller and the processor shall designate a data protection officer in any case where the processing is carried out by a public authority or body.
label: insufficient
rationale: Art. 37(1)(a) span: one mandatory case; neither establishes 'every company' nor refutes it (other Art. 37 cases not quoted)
